entities.name: Sequence number
entities.description: The NAS message sequence number (SN) which consists of the eight least significant bits of the NAS COUNT for a security protected NAS message.

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: The full counter value used for NAS security protection, from which the sequence number is derived.

entities.name: Security protected NAS message
entities.description: A NAS message that has been protected using NAS security mechanisms.

relations.description: The sequence number IE contains the eight least significant bits of the NAS COUNT.
The sequence number IE is used in security protected NAS messages.
The usage of sequence number is specified in clause 4.4.3.
